messages:
maia: heads up — deploybot put release v1.14.0 apply into HOLD during preflight.

deploy-bot: PREFLIGHT: drift-detected on module 'vpc/network' -> lockfile mismatch. Auto-hold set. See plan excerpt below.

alex: copying plan snippet. looks like route53 change plus provider upgrade.

jun: can you paste the plan lines? concerned about state migration during rush window.

maia: sure
```
# terraform plan excerpt
-/+ module.vpc.aws_route_table_association.main
  ~ aws_route_table.main
    provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"] ~> 4.6.0 -> 5.0.0
```

tim: provider pin mismatch — we've pinned infra stacks to aws v4 in this release window. the lockfile shows 5.x.

sre-oncall: is this from the upstream module bump or local change?

alex: upstream module bumped in vendor/modules/network 2 hours ago, forgot to bump module pin in staging.

maia: deploybot also logged: `apply blocked by policy 'provider-pin'`

deploy-bot: ACTION: hold created by policy 'preflight:provider-pin' at 2345678901. To override: `/deploybot override --reason "emergency" --ack @sre-oncall` (requires 2 approvers)

jun: prefer rollback of the module bump to keep window. we don't have time to validate 5.x provider across all regions.

tim: agree. quick options:
- revert module bump (preferred)
- run staggered canary (longer)
- upgrade providers and schedule validation (delayed)

maia: product-release said this surge needs to go out tonight. we should pick revert+apply during window.

sre-oncall: @maia @alex i'll take ownership for revert PR and coordinate canary merge. ping me when PR ready.

alex: opening PR now to pin vendor/modules/network to v2.4.3 and lock provider to 4.6.0.

maia: once PR is merged, i'll re-run preflight and request deploybot unhold.

deploy-bot: NOTE: unhold requires 'preflight:ok' and at least one human ack from 'eng-infra'.

tim: tagging this in release notes: "temporary revert of network module bump to ensure stability during high-traffic release." keep a follow-up ticket for provider upgrade testing.

maia: thanks team. short checklist:
- alex: PR + tag
- sre-oncall: verify canary post-apply
- tim: update release notes
- maia: re-run preflight

alex: PR merged 2345678940. tagging @sre-oncall for verification.

sre-oncall: saw the merge. re-running preflight now.

deploy-bot: PREFLIGHT: all checks passed. hold cleared at 2345678972.

maia: proceeding to queue. deploybot will start serial applies at 2345678975.

tim: leaving a note in the release thread about the temporary pin and next steps.

maia: :thumbsup:
